{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of unique sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print("Number of unique sites:", len(unique_sites))
print("Unique sites:", sorted(unique_sites))

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
print("Number of patients with multiple rows:", len(duplicates))

# Deduplicate based on highest sample_seq per patient
# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates (keep highest sample_seq)
deduplicated_df = filtered_df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Correct assay_batch B values (divide by 10)
deduplicated_df.loc[deduplicated_df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = deduplicated_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Print all required values
print("Number of unique sites:", len(unique_sites))
print("Response rates by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)
print("Highest response rate:", response_rate_by_site.max())
print("Site with highest response rate:", response_rate_by_site.idxmax())
print("Number of unique patients after deduplication:", len(deduplicated_df))"}
